1 Samuel 18:6: The dancing women came out from all Israel’s cities to meet David, with tambourines, joy, and cymbals.
1 Samuel 18:7: The women led the song and said, “Saul has struck his thousands, and David his tens of thousands.”
1 Samuel 18:8: The saying appeared evil in Saul’s eyes concerning this matter, and he said, “They have given David the tens of thousands, but to me they have given the thousands.”
1 Samuel 18:9: Saul kept looking askance at David from that day onward.
